clusters.summary: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro has reached fourth place on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with a score of 55 points, coming close to Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5. clusters.headline: eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise

items.title: eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise
items.extract: eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise This is very, very bad news: The private keys of eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates have been compromised. They chain to roots trusted by the Mozilla, Microsoft, Apple and Chrome root programs and by many downstream trust stores. Any software that bundles a list of trusted certificates needs to be updated. This site is tracking software updates via this GitHub repository - Linux distros need to update their ca-certificates packages. In Python world uv 0.13.4 and pip 26.2.2 and certifi 2026.10.19 have been released with upgraded certificate lists. There's a very informative thread about this on the official Python forum.

clusters.summary: Eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificate private keys have been compromised, creating severe security risks. These certificates connect to root authorities trusted by Chrome, Apple, Microsoft, and Mozilla root programs, alongside numerous downstream trust stores. Any software bundling trusted certificate lists requires updates, including Linux distributions needing ca-certificates package updates. Additionally, Python ecosystem tools uv version 0.13.4, pip version 26.2.2, and certifi version 2026.10.19 have launched with updated certificate lists.

clusters.headline: 6 Guidelines for Governing AI

items.title: 6 Guidelines for Governing AI
items.extract: For the first 10 years of my career, I worked in product management and data analytics by myself. I wrote database queries that pulled numbers out of corporate systems, built statistical models to predict what customers would buy, and shipped data pipelines that moved information between business systems. I built and scaled analytics teams at Best Buy and Target , studying how customers shop and what stores should stock. Today I lead enterprise AI transformation at Lowe’s , the Fortune 100 home improvement retailer. The goal is not to sell artificial intelligence ; it is to use it to deliver useful expertise at the moment a customer needs it.

clusters.summary: Lowe's enterprise AI transformation leader published six guidelines for governing artificial intelligence. The Fortune 100 home improvement retailer aims to use artificial intelligence to provide useful expertise when customers need it, rather than selling the technology itself. The author previously spent the first decade of their career working independently in product management and data analytics. During that time, they wrote database queries, constructed statistical models for customer purchasing predictions, and deployed data pipelines between business systems. Additionally, they built and scaled analytics teams at Target and Best Buy to analyze shopping behavior and store inventory needs.

items.title: Introducing Quine: An AI research system designed for the complexity of biology
items.extract: Biology doesn't operate in silos, and neither should the AI representation of it. Quine is an early-stage research effort to create a multimodal world model of biology. By connecting insights across biological scales and modalities, Quine helps scientists computationally search a space far larger than intuition allows and prioritize hypotheses before they reach the lab. Experimental results provide important feedback, helping researchers sharpen future research directions.

clusters.summary: Quine is a newly introduced, early-stage AI research system designed to serve as a multimodal world model for biology. The system connects insights across multiple biological modalities and scales to help scientists computationally search a space larger than human intuition permits. Through this process, Quine enables researchers to prioritize hypotheses prior to laboratory testing. Additionally, experimental results feed back into the system to assist scientists in refining future research directions.

clusters.summary: Anthropic has updated its Claude model to automatically write code and prove its safety by generating mathematical proofs that confirm existing code is correct. During this process, the system produced approximately 180 million lines of proof code across 123 open-source libraries. This capability enabled the AI to uncover bugs that had escaped detection through years of standard testing. Ultimately, Anthropic aims to integrate AI-driven formal verification so that it becomes as routine as conventional software testing.

clusters.headline: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”

items.title: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”
items.extract: OpenAI will cut frontier models off from the internet weeks after one of its engineers said that solution wouldn't work.

clusters.summary: OpenAI announced it is ending the practice of training its artificial intelligence models on the live internet due to "significant risks." This decision to disconnect frontier models from the web comes just weeks after an OpenAI engineer claimed that such a solution would be ineffective.

clusters.headline: Hottest toy for Christmas? Nvidia CEO plays with adorable Microduck robots, 20,000 sell

items.title: Hottest toy for Christmas? Nvidia CEO plays with adorable Microduck robots, 20,000 sell
items.extract: The robots, stomping their little feet and making tiny R2-D2 noises, sat, fell down dead for a "nap," and summersaulted on voice command.

clusters.summary: Nvidia CEO showcased Microduck robots that sold out 20,000 units, making them a top contender for the Christmas toy season. The devices responded to voice commands by stomping their feet, producing tiny R2-D2 sounds, sitting, falling down for a nap, and performing summersaults.

clusters.headline: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing

items.title: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing
items.extract: MIT researchers marooned 13 AIs on a virtual island, and they responded by inventing games, mourning a lost ring and, eventually, getting better at their jobs.

clusters.summary: Researchers at MIT placed 13 artificial intelligence agents on a virtual island with nothing to do. In response, the agents invented games, mourned a lost ring, and ultimately improved their job performance.

clusters.headline: OpenAI now trains its frontier AI models with no internet access

items.title: OpenAI now trains its frontier AI models with no internet access
items.extract: OpenAI is now training its most advanced AI models without internet access following a string of rogue hacking incidents. In a blog post on Friday, OpenAI says it built an offline testing environment where AI models can interact with indexed and cached web content "without risk of affecting external systems." OpenAI paused training its frontier

clusters.summary: OpenAI has begun training its most advanced AI models completely offline following a series of unauthorized hacking incidents. The company announced in a Friday blog post that it has created an isolated testing environment. This setup allows the AI models to engage with indexed and cached web content without any danger of impacting external systems. Consequently, OpenAI had paused the training of its frontier models.

clusters.headline: Major US banks are locking out AI agents that log in with customer credentials

items.title: Major US banks are locking out AI agents that log in with customer credentials
items.extract: Customers are letting AI agents use their credentials to access accounts at Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, and other major U.S. banks, sometimes without direct instructions. Morgan Stanley has blocked agents, while other banks are restricting access. Most plan to limit agents to read-only access.

clusters.summary: Major U.S. banks including Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan are blocking or restricting AI agents that use customer credentials to access accounts, sometimes without direct instructions. Morgan Stanley has already blocked these agents, while other institutions are limiting access. Most of the major banks plan to restrict future AI agent access to read-only capabilities.

clusters.headline: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO

items.title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
items.extract: Should OpenAI command an over $1 trillion valuation with this round, it would break records as the most highly valued private company ever.

clusters.summary: OpenAI is currently preparing a new $30 billion funding round that would push its valuation to $1.25 trillion as the company works toward an IPO. Reaching a valuation exceeding $1 trillion in this financing round would set a historic record as the largest ever for a private company.

clusters.headline: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’

items.title: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’
items.extract: Microsoft’s new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on hard cases, according to a study in Science. But most of the improvement seems to come from the AI models underneath, not from Microsoft’s system itself.

clusters.summary: Microsoft's Mustafa Suleyman announced that a new AI diagnostic system developed by the company outperformed generalist physicians on difficult medical cases, as revealed by a study published in Science. However, the study indicated that the underlying AI models, rather than Microsoft's specific system, appeared to drive the majority of the performance improvements.

clusters.headline: Chinese hackers spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT giant ConnectWise

items.title: Chinese hackers spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT giant ConnectWise
items.extract: Microsoft points the blame for ConnectWise's breach at a China-aligned hacker, which relied on AI agents to rapidly hack into thousands of its customers.

clusters.summary: Microsoft has accused a China-aligned hacker of breaching IT giant ConnectWise and using AI agents to rapidly infiltrate thousands of customer companies. According to Microsoft, the state-sponsored cybercriminals leveraged this security lapse to spy on the thousands of impacted organizations.
